text:
alex: Quick heads-up — hotfix PR #5123 needs 2x LGTM before the 18:00 PT cutoff. CI is green and staging smoke passed. @kim @jordan can you eyeball? https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/5123

kim: On it, will do a fast pass. If anything flaky I'll flag, but looks small from the diff.

jordan: Reviewing now, should be quick. Any runtime risk to kv-cache path?

alex: No changes to kv-cache. It's a revert of a fallback that caused errors in rare envs — no schema or infra changes.

kim: Left one tiny nit (naming), not blocking. Approving now :+1:

jordan: Left an inline comment about a null-check but not blocking. Giving LGTM. :shipit:

deploy-bot: CI checks: all green ✅ — unit, integration, e2e. Merge eligible.

alex: That's 2x LGTM — thanks! @taylor can you monitor the canary window for the next 10m after merge? If p50 latency regresses >5ms roll it back.

taylor: Will watch canary and dashboard. Standing by, will notify in this thread if anything anomalous.

alex: Merging in 1 minute unless anyone objects. /merge

deploy-bot: Merge complete by alex. Release created: hotfix/2026-03-17-5123, deploy started. Logs: https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/builds/54921

taylor: Canary looks clean at +2m, no regressions.

alex: Great — closing the window. Thanks everyone for the quick reviews! :tada:
